mapper.sql: WITH ics_class AS ( SELECT * FROM ics21_checklist_l_class LEFT OUTER JOIN ics22_checklist_l_class_company ON ( ics22_checklist_l_class_id = ics21_checklist_l_class_id AND ics22_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) INNER JOIN ics23_checklist_m_class ON ( ics23_checklist_l_class_id = ics21_checklist_l_class_id AND ics23_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ics24_checklist_m_class_company ON ( ics24_checklist_m_class_id = ics23_checklist_m_class_id AND ics24_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) WHERE ics21_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics21_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics21_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics21_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics22_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics22_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics22_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics23_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics23_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics23_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics24_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics24_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics24_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT ics10_checklist_id AS checklist_id, ics10_company_id AS company_id, ics10_content AS content, ics10_criterion AS criterion, ics10_use_yn AS use_yn, ics10_checklist_m_class_id AS checklist_m_class_id, ics10_seq AS seq, a.ics23_checklist_l_class_nm AS check_l_class_name, a.ics23_checklist_m_class_nm AS check_m_class_name, a.ics23_checklist_l_class_id AS check_l_class_id, a.ics23_checklist_l_class_seq AS check_l_class_seq, a.ics23_seq AS check_m_class_seq FROM ics10_checklist INNER JOIN ( SELECT ics23_checklist_m_class.* , ( SELECT ics21_checklist_l_class_nm FROM ics21_checklist_l_class WHERE ics21_checklist_l_class_id = ics23_checklist_l_class_id ) AS ics23_checklist_l_class_nm , ( SELECT ics21_seq FROM ics21_checklist_l_class WHERE ics21_checklist_l_class_id = ics23_checklist_l_class_id ) AS ics23_checklist_l_class_seq FROM ics23_checklist_m_class WHERE ics23_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) a ON ics23_checklist_m_class_id = ics10_checklist_m_class_id WHERE ics10_checklist_id = #{checklistId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics10_checklist ( ics10_checklist_id, ics10_company_id, ics10_content, ics10_criterion, ics10_use_yn, ics10_checklist_m_class_id, ics10_seq ) VALUES ( #{req.checklistId}, #{companyId}, #{req.content}, #{req.criterion}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.checklistMClassId}, #{req.seq} )
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(ics21_checklist_l_class_id AS VARCHAR) AS code, ics21_checklist_l_class_nm AS name FROM ics_class GROUP BY ics21_company_id, ics21_checklist_l_class_id, ics21_checklist_l_class_nm, ics21_seq ORDER BY ics21_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics11_checklist_company ( ics11_checklist_company_id, ics11_company_id, ics11_checklist_id, ics11_write_group_id, ics11_use_yn ) VALUES ( #{rowId}, #{companyId}, #{checklistId}, #{writeGroupId}, #{useYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT ics21_checklist_l_class_id FROM ics21_checklist_l_class WHERE ics21_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND replace(ics21_checklist_l_class_nm, ' ', '') = #{className} LIMIT 1
